mapping.archive: all members in archive order and exact digest; non-USFM support files explicitly accounted as retained support members
mapping.book: source member filename and id line; FRT/GLO are separate front/back TEI divisions
mapping.headings: heading markers map to ordered nested TEI divisions with an exact source-labeled head

inline.f/x: attached TEI note type footnote/cross-reference; caller marker, labels, note text, alternate readings, and target references remain structured
inline.unrecognized: conversion fails closed; retain exact source feature and record explicit gap before any mapping extension
inline.w/+w: TEI w; source lexical text in element content and Strong's identifier in @n

mapping.other_markers: source-labeled TEI seg inside p blocks within source-line divisions when outside chapters; blank lines use milestones
mapping.paragraphs: blank \p markers mapped to TEI milestone
mapping.verse: each explicit \v marker maps to one verse ab; inline words, notes, cross references, quotation scopes, Hebrew spans, Selah, glossary terms and titles map to readable TEI with exact source-span pointers

mutation_claims: omit, duplicate, or reorder source line
change a source line marker or payload
change verse text, number, chapter, or book identity
change archive member order, bytes, CRC, or hash
invent unsupported source line or TEI root
leave an opaque inline command in readable text
drop, reorder, detach, or alter a lexical word, Strong identifier, note, caller, note field, cross-reference target, quotation, Hebrew span, or glossary term
remove or falsify an inline source-span pointer
